old_problem: The same Code identifies both this read-only PCH sensor row and a separate destructive MODS NVMe/E1.S row; DeepSeek contaminated evidence between them. Its `sensor get` target is also the testcase title rather than a proven SDR ID. Historical review additionally treated the 1/2/10 list-number gap as potentially hidden PCH criteria, although the source contains no such text.
disposition_reason: Resolve Pending and Source Conflict. ED-02 requires keeping the shared Code's Source Key/Variant identities separate, so row-2201 MODS commands/evidence are never applicable here. The explicit PCH coverage is implementable as complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor-list reconciliation plus full WebUI visual evidence against a versioned PCH SPEC. TEMP_PCH is only an approved derived view after raw capture. Criteria labels 1/2/10 are an editorial defect; ED-01/30 prohibit inventing absent 3–9. Exact PCH sensor set, values and mappings are runtime Project Configuration.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2012, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, duplicate row-2201 identity, ED-01 through ED-30 and ipmitool/OpenBMC documentation were read; the actual next queue row was directly opened as Functionality 2013 / Wistron-BMC-01033-V002 / f55bb6b829634b6c.
Source Key plus Variant ID bind this review to PCH sensors; the same Code does not authorize MODS/NVMe/E1.S procedures or storage outputs to cross the variant boundary.
ipmitool supports complete SDR and sensor-list enumeration. `TEMP_PCH` filtering is useful only after retaining raw inventories and validating the exact PCH record crosswalk.
A PCH may expose temperature, status or discrete records with OEM names and dynamic readings; the versioned platform SPEC must define population, units, tolerances, freshness and applicable Web rows.
The only written Criteria are SDR, Sensor List and Web SPEC parity. Number 10 is retained as a typo; no evidence supports reconstructing requirements 3–9.
No ipmitool, authentication, PCH sensor read, Web login/capture, MODS/storage command, log clear, BMC, host or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Variant-bound complete PCH sensor SPEC parity across IB/OOB IPMI and BMC Web
test_case.purpose: Verify every required PCH sensor record and its identity, description, reading semantics and status against the exact PCH SPEC across complete in-band/out-of-band SDR and Sensor lists plus complete BMC Web evidence, without admitting same-Code MODS storage data.
required_package: Exact SUT/BMC/BIOS/PCH device, stepping and firmware identities plus versioned PCH sensor SPEC
Per-record PCH-to-IB-SDR/IB-list/OOB-SDR/OOB-list/Web crosswalk including valid TEMP_PCH aliases, units, states, thresholds and applicability
Approved ipmitool build/in-band privileges, trusted management access and protected OOB/Web sessions
Aligned sampling, allowed PCH-temperature dynamics, rounding, freshness/stale/unavailable, duplicate/missing/extra and Web cache/pagination rules
Full screenshot/export redaction/hash policy, retained anomaly logs and explicit separation from row-2201 MODS variant
test_case.test_command: READ-ONLY PACKAGE-GATED; verify Source Key/Variant and mark row-2201 MODS storage actions out of scope. Preserve logs without clearing. Capture complete untruncated IB `sdr elist` and `sensor list`, then complete OOB equivalents through trusted secret-safe access at aligned times. Retain raw outputs before applying the approved PCH/TEMP_PCH crosswalk; never query `Sensor Check - PCH` as an assumed SDR ID or rely on grep/head alone. Capture every BMC Web Sensor page with target/time/navigation context and compare each mapped PCH name, description, reading/unit/status/threshold/freshness and population with SPEC and across views. No writes, heating stimulus, storage test or automatic retry.
test_case.expected_result: The exact approved PCH sensor population appears once in every applicable IPMI/Web view; identities, descriptions, units/status/thresholds and time-aligned readings conform to the PCH SPEC and dynamic tolerance, with complete visible Web evidence, no variant contamination and no disallowed anomaly.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact row/variant binding, complete raw IB/OOB inventories, all Web pages and per-record PCH SPEC/cross-view agreement under approved tolerance/freshness rules. FAIL on MODS evidence substitution, missing/extra/duplicate PCH record, wrong alias/description/unit/state/threshold, out-of-range/stale/unavailable reading, cross-view mismatch, truncation/pagination omission or disallowed new log. Missing SPEC/crosswalk is NOT READY; 1/2/10 numbering neither supplies hidden checks nor permits omission; end user owns verdict.
safety_gate: Bind variant ae8124320a145891; prohibit every row-2201 MODS/NVMe/E1.S action and evidence substitution.
Read-only sensor collection only; no log clear, threshold/BMC writes, PCH stimulus or storage activity.
Use protected trusted access, retain full lists before filtering and capture all Web pages; stop on identity/mapping/data ambiguity.
No automatic retry; preserve first discrepancy, raw outputs, screenshots and logs.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash and explicit shared-Code row-2201 isolation audit
SUT/BMC/BIOS/PCH identities, versioned PCH SPEC and five-view record crosswalk/tolerances
Complete timestamped IB/OOB SDR elist and Sensor list outputs, exit status and hashes
Complete BMC Web screenshots/export with navigation, pagination, target and time
Per-record PCH SPEC/IB/OOB/Web comparison, population/missing-extra-duplicate analysis and dynamic-reading decision
No-MODS/no-write/no-clear/no-retry audit, retained anomaly logs and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong variant/target, access, list, Web, mapping, freshness or comparison failure, stop read-only collection, close/revoke sessions and preserve the first PCH outputs/screenshots/logs. Rotate exposed credentials. Do not run MODS, clear logs, alter thresholds or retry insecurely; escalate exact record IDs to the BMC/PCH owner.
